description: Find locations with an Archive warp or public render captured within inclusive historical dates. For when records were added/modified in Atlas use find_recently_added_or_modified. Capture dates are not founding/destruction dates. Year/month-only dates match overlapping ranges; captureDatePrecision distinguishes them. Prefer interactiveUrl for human links and citations. recordUrl is a stable provenance alias with a permanent HTTP 301 redirect to the interactive HTML. Use apiUrl or JSONL for JSON. Derivatives use locationInteractiveUrl/locationRecordUrl.

dimension.description: Optional Minecraft dimension: 0 Overworld, 1 Nether, or 2 End.

from.description: Inclusive start date in YYYY-MM-DD form.

limit.description: Maximum results, from 1 to 100. Defaults to 20.

to.description: Inclusive end date in YYYY-MM-DD form.

name: find_locations_by_time_range
